full_judgment: 36. Upon sifting the evidences of P.Ws. and O.P.Ws. I am of the view that the pre-emptor is admittedly the co-sharer of the case jote. The Appellate Court also found that the O.P.W No. I in cross admitted that in the Oshiatnama there is a name of 3 sons and 1 (one) daughter of Abdus Sattar namely Abdul Hamid Siddique, Zinnoth Ali Siddique, Halim Siddique and Miya (মায়া) Siddique. It is also found by the Court of appeal below that the opposite party No. I also admitted in the cross that the pro-emptor has 3 (three) brother and I (one) sister. More-so, upon a bare reading of the Oshiatnama-exhibit-2 dated 07.04.1960 it appears that Abdus Sattar had 3 sons and 1 daughter. The Court of appeal below rightly found and opined that the pre-emptor is the co-sharer of the case jote. So, both the Courts concurrently found that pre-emptor and pre-emptee No. 2 are the co-sharer by inheritance of the suit plots and Khatian.
